nodes.summary: The bijection `{0, 1}^ι ≃ {0, 1}^κ` induced by `e : κ ≃ ι`.
nodes.title: Cube bijection induced by an index bijection

nodes.summary: On `Fin n`, the Fourier coefficient is `BooleanCube.boolFourierCoeff` up to the sign `(-1)^{|S|}`.
nodes.title: Walsh coefficient is the canonical Fourier coefficient up to sign

nodes.summary: Fourier coefficients are unchanged when both the function and its index are reindexed.
nodes.title: Fourier coefficients are invariant under reindexing

nodes.summary: The Fourier–Walsh coefficient `f̂(S) = 𝔼[f χ_S]` under the uniform measure.
nodes.title: Fourier–Walsh coefficient under the uniform measure

nodes.summary: Fourier inversion: `f = ∑_S f̂(S) χ_S`.
nodes.title: Fourier inversion on the Boolean cube

nodes.summary: Bonami–Beckner hypercontractive inequality (A. Bonami, *Étude des coefficients de Fourier des fonctions de Lᵖ(G)*, Ann. Inst. Fourier 1970; W. Beckner, *Inequalities in Fourier analysis*, Ann. of Math. 1975): `‖T_ρ g‖₂ ≤ ‖g‖_{1+ρ²}` on `{0, 1}^ι` for `0 ≤ ρ ≤ 1`.
nodes.title: Bonami–Beckner hypercontractive inequality

nodes.summary: Event influence is four times canonical quarter-square influence after reindexing.
nodes.title: Event influence is four times the canonical influence

nodes.summary: The influence of `e` on a Boolean function is `∑_{S ∋ e} 4 f̂(S)²`.
nodes.title: Influence of a coordinate as Fourier weight

nodes.summary: The Fourier form `khc_LogSobolevStep c` implies the KKL inequality `KKLHypercontractive (1/2) c`.
nodes.title: Hypercontractive form of KKL implies the KKL inequality at $p = 1/2$

nodes.summary: `khc_LogSobolevStep 0` holds trivially.
nodes.title: Hypercontractive form of KKL with constant 0 holds trivially

nodes.summary: The KKL inequality at `p = 1/2` in Fourier form, with the hypercontractive bound as a hypothesis: for every Boolean `φ`, if `∑_S ρ^{2|S|} f̂(S)² ≤ ‖f‖²_{1+ρ²}` for all `ρ ∈ [0, 1]`, then `c · ∑_{S ≠ ∅} f̂(S)² · log (1 / maxₑ Infₑ(f)) ≤ ∑_S 4 |S| f̂(S)²`, where `f = 1_φ`. The hypothesis always holds (`khc_lowDegreeWeight_le`).
nodes.title: Fourier-form KKL inequality given the hypercontractive bound

nodes.summary: Hypercontractivity in Fourier form: `∑_S ρ^{2|S|} f̂(S)² ≤ ‖f‖²_{1+ρ²}`.
nodes.title: Hypercontractivity in Fourier form

nodes.summary: The noise operator acts diagonally on the Walsh basis: `T_ρ f = ∑_S ρ^{|S|} f̂(S) χ_S`.
nodes.title: Noise operator is diagonal in the Walsh basis

nodes.summary: Parseval's identity: `𝔼[f g] = ∑_S f̂(S) ĝ(S)`.
nodes.title: Parseval's identity on the Boolean cube

nodes.summary: Reindexing back at the corresponding cube point recovers the original value.
nodes.title: Reindexing preserves values at corresponding cube points

nodes.summary: The function `f` on `{0, 1}^ι` transported to `{0, 1}^κ` along the bijection `e : κ ≃ ι`.
nodes.title: Reindexing a cube function along an index bijection

nodes.summary: The `±1` value of a bit: `false ↦ 1`, `true ↦ -1`.
nodes.title: $\pm 1$ value of a bit

nodes.summary: The total influence of a Boolean function is `∑_S 4 |S| f̂(S)²`.
nodes.title: Total influence as Fourier weight

nodes.summary: Variance under the uniform measure is the Fourier weight off the empty set.
nodes.title: Variance as Fourier weight off the empty set

nodes.summary: On `Fin n`, the variance under the uniform product weight is `BooleanCube.boolVariance`.
nodes.title: Uniform variance agrees with the canonical Boolean variance

nodes.summary: On `Fin n`, the Walsh character is `BooleanCube.cubeChi` up to the sign `(-1)^{|S|}`: `BooleanCube.cubeVal` sends `true` to `1`, while `khc_sign` sends it to `-1`.
nodes.title: Walsh character agrees with the canonical cube character up to sign

nodes.summary: Reindexing a Walsh character reindexes its finite set of coordinates.
nodes.title: Reindexing a Walsh character reindexes its coordinate set

nodes.summary: The Walsh character `χ_S(x) = ∏_{i ∈ S} (-1)^{x i}` on `{0, 1}^ι`.
nodes.title: Walsh character on the Boolean cube
